post.description:
What the bridge signed (notes, change, receipts, staff operations); idempotent. The
answer carries the signed acknowledgement the bridge needs to mark them as synced.

get.description:
The idle screen: the café menu (the subscription offers come from the public
configurator, by `location_slug`).

post.description: §8.3 flow 6: the credit in the account pays.
§8.3 flow 4: the 3-step configurator (R-081); then it is paid like any item.
§8.3 flow 4: freezing (R-086).
§8.3 flow 6: a voucher of the card holder, used here (R-121).

get.description: LG-134: the winners of every closed season (Season 0 has no prizes).
LG-051: the Kings of the Jungle — the 10 best eligible Masters (computed, not stored).

§9.2.6: the level simulator on the website. Nothing is stored; the level is the official
questionnaire's estimate of the pre-filled answers (R-003, Q47), which a coach validates.

§9.2.7: the points simulator. The LP of one plain doubles match, computed by the league
engine with the running season's values; nothing about any player is read or stored.
§6.15: today's Match of the day, with what is at stake.
Private statistics: only the player sees them (R-012).
Challenges are issued and answered at the League Kiosk; here they are only shown.

The player's matches and where each one is (§6.9). Scores are entered only at the
League Kiosk: there is no way to enter or confirm one from here (invariant 1).
Q6: season rewards waiting for the winner's choice.
Q49: a player's public page: rank, level, LP, place and match history.

post.description: R-003: the level questionnaire; a coach validates it before the first league match.

get.description: Q49: the latest league match results.
LG-057 order; players in placement are not ranked yet.
§6.14: registrations, draws and results, live on the website.

post.description:
A tournament entry is like a booking (it changes nothing in the league); the entry fee
is paid like any other item (it is the payment condition of the matches).
§12.2: personal data is removed; you stay as "Jucător retras" in others' history.

get.description: GDPR art. 15 and 20: everything we hold about you, as a JSON file.

ADR-0012: the token is shown once; enrolling again replaces it.
A staff member who handles cash sets their PIN for the kiosk's staff mode (Q54).

Q28: the director marks a tournament match finished; the score is then entered and
confirmed at the League Kiosk.

get.description: Disputed, expired, waiting for payment … (LG-095), with the log of every step.

post.description: Final standings, rewards as vouchers, the Hall of Fame (§6.12, §6.13).
Every paid entry fee comes back as credit in the account.

get.description: The café's whole menu, the products taken off it included.
The kiosks' cash boxes, the safe, and the latest staff operations with the Z reports.
The seven days from `week_of` (club time), cancelled classes included.
The day's opening hours in club time (Q3), for the calendar's rows.
Every season, the planned ones included, for the league's administration.
The period's revenue per category, bookings, occupancy and classes (club days).
`kind=transactions` (the ledger entries, for the accountant) or `kind=bookings`.
Every resource of the location, the inactive ones included.
Who holds a staff role here, and what each role may do (§8.1).
The latest subscriptions of the location (at most 200), optionally of one status.
The release, the server's clock, the database and cache, the location's devices.
The ledger transactions of a club day (at most 200), with their entries.
